name: Aggregate
notes: immediate (not deferred). Seedless overload throws InvalidOperationException when source is empty; seeded overloads do not.

name: AggregateBy
notes: deferred. Comparer param is optional-with-default (IEqualityComparer<TKey>? = null) so the doc lists 2 rows, both comparer-taking. Like GroupBy but folds each group instead of allocating a collection per group.

name: All
notes: immediate. Returns true for an empty sequence.

name: Any
notes: immediate. Overload with predicate and without.

name: Append
notes: deferred. Single-element append, not sequence concat.

name: AsEnumerable
notes: identity cast to IEnumerable<T>; used to force the Enumerable overload over IQueryable. No Rust analogue needed.

name: Average
notes: immediate. 20 overloads = 5 numeric types x {plain, nullable} x {no selector, selector}. Non-nullable overloads throw InvalidOperationException on empty; nullable ones return null. Can throw OverflowException.

name: Cast
notes: deferred. Extends non-generic IEnumerable. Throws InvalidCastException on a bad element. No safe Rust analogue.

name: Chunk
notes: deferred. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException if size < 1. Yields TSource[] chunks; last chunk may be shorter.

name: Concat
notes: deferred.

name: Contains
notes: immediate.

name: Count
notes: immediate. Int32; overflows for huge sequences (use LongCount).

name: CountBy
notes: deferred. Comparer param is optional-with-default so only 1 doc row exists and it is comparer-taking. Yields KeyValuePair<TKey,int>.

name: DefaultIfEmpty
notes: deferred. Yields a one-element sequence when source is empty.

name: Distinct
notes: deferred. Hash-based (IEqualityComparer), not sort-based.

name: DistinctBy
notes: deferred. Comparer applies to the key, not the element.

name: ElementAt
notes: immediate. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException. Int32 and System.Index overloads (Index overload added net-6.0).

name: ElementAtOrDefault
notes: immediate. Int32 and System.Index overloads (Index overload added net-6.0). No throw.

name: Empty
notes: static generator on Enumerable; free function in Rust. Returns a cached empty sequence.

name: Except
notes: deferred. Set difference; buffers the second sequence.

name: ExceptBy
notes: deferred. Second sequence is IEnumerable<TKey>, not IEnumerable<TSource>.

name: First
notes: immediate. Throws InvalidOperationException when the source sequence is empty (or no element matches the predicate).

name: FirstOrDefault
notes: immediate. 4 overloads: {no predicate, predicate} x {no defaultValue, defaultValue}; the defaultValue pair was added net-6.0.

name: FullJoin
notes: NOT IN .NET 10 - net-11.0 preview only. Excluded from the .NET 10 totals. Both overloads take a comparer (optional-with-default).

name: GroupBy
notes: deferred. 8 overloads = {key only, key+element, key+result, key+element+result} x {no comparer, comparer}. Yields IGrouping<TKey,TElement>.

name: GroupJoin
notes: deferred. 2 overloads in net-10 (with and without comparer); net-11 adds a third, result-selector-less overload.

name: Index
notes: deferred. Yields (int Index, TSource Item) tuples; equivalent to Rust Iterator::enumerate.

name: InfiniteSequence
notes: static generator on Enumerable; free function in Rust. Never terminates; T is INumber<T>-constrained (start, step).

name: Intersect
notes: deferred. Buffers the second sequence.

name: IntersectBy
notes: deferred. Second sequence is IEnumerable<TKey>.

name: Join
notes: deferred. Inner (equi) join. 2 overloads in net-10 (with and without comparer); net-11 adds a third, result-selector-less overload. Renamed inner_join in this crate (W-12).

name: Last
notes: immediate. Throws InvalidOperationException when the source sequence is empty.

name: LastOrDefault
notes: immediate. 4 overloads; defaultValue pair added net-6.0.

name: LeftJoin
notes: deferred. Added net-10.0. 2 overloads in net-10; net-11 adds a result-selector-less overload.

name: LongCount
notes: immediate. Int64 counterpart of Count.

name: Max
notes: immediate. 23 overloads = 10 numeric/nullable-numeric + 10 selector forms + generic no-arg + generic selector + IComparer overload (IComparer overload added net-6.0). Throws InvalidOperationException on empty for non-nullable value types; returns null for nullable/reference element types.

name: MaxBy
notes: immediate. Returns the element, not the key. Comparer applies to the key.

name: Min
notes: immediate. Same 23-overload shape as Max, including the net-6.0 IComparer overload. Same empty-sequence behaviour.

name: MinBy
notes: immediate. Returns the element, not the key.

name: OfType
notes: deferred. Extends non-generic IEnumerable; filters by runtime type. No Rust analogue.

name: Order
notes: deferred, added net-7.0. Sorts by the element itself; stable.

name: OrderBy
notes: deferred. Stable sort (documented). Returns IOrderedEnumerable<T>, which is what makes ThenBy possible - a Rust port needs the same two-stage type.

name: OrderByDescending
notes: deferred. Stable sort. Returns IOrderedEnumerable<T>.

name: OrderDescending
notes: deferred, added net-7.0. Sorts by the element itself, descending.

name: Prepend
notes: deferred. Single-element prepend.

name: Range
notes: static generator on Enumerable; free function in Rust. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException on negative count or overflow. Int32 only.

name: Repeat
notes: static generator on Enumerable; free function in Rust. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException on negative count. Bounded (count), unlike Rust iter::repeat.

name: Reverse
notes: deferred but buffers the entire source. 2 overloads in net-10: the classic IEnumerable<TSource> one and Reverse<TSource>(TSource[]) added net-10.0 to disambiguate from MemoryExtensions.Reverse.

name: RightJoin
notes: deferred. Added net-10.0. 2 overloads in net-10; net-11 adds a result-selector-less overload.

name: Select
notes: deferred. 2 overloads: selector and indexed selector.

name: SelectMany
notes: deferred. 4 overloads = {selector, indexed selector} x {no result selector, result selector}.

name: Sequence
notes: static generator on Enumerable; free function in Rust. Added net-10.0. (start, endInclusive, step); T is INumber<T>-constrained. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException on a step that cannot reach the end.

name: SequenceEqual
notes: immediate. Element-wise equality plus length equality.

name: Shuffle
notes: deferred, added net-10.0. Docs state randomization uses a non-cryptographically-secure RNG. Needs a source of randomness, so a zero-dependency Rust port cannot match it without an RNG.

name: Single
notes: immediate. Throws InvalidOperationException both when the sequence is empty and when it has more than one element.

name: SingleOrDefault
notes: immediate. Still throws InvalidOperationException when more than one element matches; only the empty case returns the default. 4 overloads; defaultValue pair added net-6.0.

name: Skip
notes: deferred. Negative count is treated as zero.

name: SkipLast
notes: deferred, added netcore-2.0. Buffers a window of count elements.

name: SkipWhile
notes: deferred. 2 overloads: predicate and indexed predicate.

name: Sum
notes: immediate. 20 overloads with the same shape as Average. Returns zero (not an error) for an empty sequence. Can throw OverflowException in a checked context.

name: Take
notes: deferred. 2 overloads: Int32 count and System.Range (Range overload added net-6.0).

name: TakeLast
notes: deferred, added netcore-2.0. Buffers a window of count elements.

name: TakeWhile
notes: deferred. 2 overloads: predicate and indexed predicate.

name: ThenBy
notes: deferred. Extension on IOrderedEnumerable<T>, NOT on IEnumerable<T> - only callable after OrderBy/Order. Stable secondary sort.

name: ThenByDescending
notes: deferred. Extension on IOrderedEnumerable<T>, not on IEnumerable<T>.

name: ToArray
notes: immediate.

name: ToDictionary
notes: immediate. Throws ArgumentException on duplicate keys. 8 overloads in net-10; the KeyValuePair and ValueTuple source overloads were added net-8.0.

name: ToHashSet
notes: immediate, added netcore-2.0.

name: ToList
notes: immediate.

name: ToLookup
notes: immediate. Returns ILookup (one-to-many), unlike ToDictionary; duplicate keys are allowed and grouped.

name: TryGetNonEnumeratedCount
notes: immediate, added net-6.0. Non-enumerating count probe via ICollection tests; typically O(1). Maps to Rust Iterator::size_hint, not to len().

name: Union
notes: deferred. Set union preserving first-seen order.

name: UnionBy
notes: deferred. Comparer applies to the key.

name: Where
notes: deferred. 2 overloads: predicate and indexed predicate.

name: Zip
notes: deferred. 3 overloads in net-10: 2-sequence with result selector (netframework-4.0), 2-sequence tuple form (netcore-3.0), 3-sequence tuple form (net-6.0). Stops at the shortest sequence.
